Answers from 2026-10-07 were fetched by Tony in his browser and recorded in the orrery's documentation/HORIZONS_ANSWERS_L395_20261007.md. Answers from 2026-10-10 were fetched by this build session through the chat's web-fetch tool, which passes a page through a reading model: their field lines are JPL's, their layout is rebuilt. Each answer's source is in sources. Re-fetched 2026-10-10: every 2026-10-07 answer used here read the same except Encke's record (G3), which JPL re-solved in place (solution date 2026-Oct-09); the recorded 2026-10-07 text is kept.
